scenario.title: The Unplanned Pitch
scenario.context: A coffee shop near a business district, mid-afternoon. The murmur of conversations and clinking of cutlery can be heard in the background. The aroma of freshly brewed coffee fills the air.
scenario.description: Two colleagues unexpectedly bump into an important client while getting coffee. They seize the opportunity to pitch a new project idea, but their client is in a rush.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Patient, tactful, and observant. She is very good at understanding social cues and managing her impulses in professional situations.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: Calm, considerate and patient. He listens carefully before speaking and respects the client's time constraints.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Impulsive and overly eager. He often interrupts others and pushes his ideas without considering the context or other people's situations.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Aggressive and impatient. He gets frustrated easily when things don't go his way, and tends to pressure others into agreeing with him.
scenario.speaker2_persona_high: Calm, considerate and patient. He listens carefully before speaking and respects the client's time constraints.
scenario.speaker2_persona_low: Aggressive and impatient. He gets frustrated easily when things don't go his way, and tends to pressure others into agreeing with him.
